name: Christmas in the Country at Cracker Country
venue: Cracker Country at the Florida State Fairgrounds
when_note: 10 AM to 4 PM, with stage performances at 11 AM, 1 PM and 3 PM
cost: $16 adults, $14 seniors, $12 ages 6 to 11, free ages 0 to 5
paras: Cracker Country at the Florida State Fairgrounds holds Christmas in the Country on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 AM to 4 PM. The fairgrounds describe it as a 19th century Florida Christmas across a four acre complex of 13 original buildings.

Guests can collect salt dough, Christmas card and paper ornaments, churn butter and wash laundry on an old fashioned washboard. Extra activities cost $2 each: dipping a beeswax candle, twisting a rope and dyeing with indigo. Bee-keeping and honey demonstrations and pine needle basket weaving are also listed.
The Main Stage hosts bands at 11 AM, 1 PM and 3 PM. The General Store sells historical toys, games, books and candy, and its proceeds support Cracker Country's field trip programs.
Advance tickets are required and there are no on-site ticket sales. Parking is $10 online or $12 onsite through the MLK entrance near Gate 2.
tip: Buy tickets and parking online ahead of time, since the fairgrounds sell no tickets at the gate.

name: Symphony in Lights at Wiregrass
when_note: Nightly shows at 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM through December 31
paras: The Shops at Wiregrass in Wesley Chapel runs its annual Symphony in Lights Christmas tree light shows and snowfall every night through December 31, 2026. Shows start at 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM.

AdventHealth Wesley Chapel presents the show, which pairs lights with soft snowflakes. The center says the shows run in various weather conditions, but severe weather may cause technical difficulties and change the schedule.
tip: Shows run at the top of each hour from 6 to 9 PM, so you can catch the show you prefer.

name: Pajama Party Fridays with Santa
when_note: Fridays through December 18, hours vary by date
paras: The Shops at Wiregrass invites families to wear cozy pajamas for Pajama Party photo nights with Santa on select Fridays. The center lists November 27, December 4, December 11 and December 18, 2026.
Hours are 11 AM to 7 PM on November 27, December 4 and December 11, and 10 AM to 8 PM on December 18. A November 20 date from 1 to 7 PM has already passed.
Families book a time slot through the center's Santa reservation page.
tip: Book a time slot online ahead of time through the center's reservation link.
host: The Shops at Wiregrass Photos with Santa

name: Sensory Santa at Wiregrass
paras: The Shops at Wiregrass hosts a Sensory Santa Photo Experience on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 9:30 to 10:30 AM. The center lists it under its Santa Cares program.
The environment is adjusted to reduce bright lights, loud sounds and long wait times, so children with sensory sensitivities can meet Santa comfortably.
The center says spots fill up fast and asks families to register in advance.
tip: Register early through the center's reservation link, since spots fill quickly.
host: The Shops at Wiregrass Santa Cares
